why: Controls below this project's own 28px coarse-pointer floor, recorded so the count cannot grow while the existing set is triaged. Not an allowance: every one of these is a real shortfall, spanning 37 control classes. Resizing them changes how the plugin feels and how nearly every capture looks, which is an operator decision rather than a repair one pass should make silently.
smallest: db-file-tag-remove at 10x14, db-multi-select-remove at 14x14, db-table-row-drag-handle at 16x16
note: db-toggle-switch measures 34x18 under a coarse pointer here, which is a second independent contradiction of roadmap 7.1's claim that the switch reaches 34x28.
